description.p: WeatherWidget puts live weather and world clocks on your desktop — a compact, transparent overlay for keeping an eye on conditions in the places that matter.

Monitor multiple cities at a glance. See temperature, humidity, wind speed and direction, weather conditions, and local time — all updating in real time. The widget is borderless and adjustable in transparency so it blends naturally with your workflow. On X11 desktops it can stay on top of your other windows; on Wayland, window stacking is managed by the compositor.
Features:

ul.li: Live weather for several cities displayed side by side
Real-time clocks showing each city's local time and date
Enhanced and Simple views with selectable data fields
Temperature, description, humidity, wind speed and direction, gusts
Dew point, pressure, UV index, pollution and Air Quality Index, Feels Like
Snap to any screen corner or drag to a custom position
Celsius or Fahrenheit, plus km/h, mph or knots for wind
Air Quality News, Definition and Profiles ticker
Ticker for weather news, forecast and warnings!
AQI: graded context: Good, Fair, Moderate, and beyond, PM2.5, PM10, NO₂, Ozone, CO

description.p: Improved: Centralized City Search in RemoteAPIAdapter.SearchCity for ui-windows, ui-darwin, ui-gtk.

Fix: Incorrect time zone: Implemented nearby-zone fallback: added internal/tzlookup. Lookup first tries the exact coordinates. If that returns nothing, it probes rings of 16 points at growing radii (0.02° up to 0.5°) and returns the most common zone from the first ring that finds one.
Improvement: Brand-New Native Windows UI: Rebuilt from the ground up to integrate cleanly with modern Windows aesthetics, typography, and window management. (Windows)
Feature: Created 3 Weather profiles to be selected in Data Settings - Real-Time Weather, Today's Forecast, Tomorrow's Forecast
Feature: Created Ticker Settings Health Profiles, Weather News & Alert Feed, Air Quality & Pollution definitions for Ticker messages
Feature: Added Free 3 selected cities (London, New York & Amsterdam) with full feature access in new design
Feature: About TAB now contains useful links to user manual, environmental policy, support page as well as Github repo page.
Linux Snap package autostart permanant fix
Windows Software rendering running without GPU (AMD64 & AMR64)
Everyday Outdoors: General atmospheric context for daily commutes and stepping out.
Runner & Cyclist: Real-time feedback on whether conditions and air quality are optimal for outdoor cardio.
Family & School Run: Practical checks when heading out with children and family.
Sensitive Airways: Targeted alerts for asthma, allergy, and pollutant sensitivity.
Open Windows: Quick guidance on whether bringing fresh outdoor air inside is a good idea.
Replaces raw microgram density confusion with clear, graded context: Good, Fair, Moderate, and beyond.
Includes human-readable descriptions alongside the standard composite AQI scale.
Granular toggles remain available if you prefer tracking individual components directly (PM2.5, PM10, NO₂, Ozone, CO).
